description: Multi-pane terminal layout with simultaneous terminals, 2-column desktop and 1-column mobile behavior aligned with app-monitor workspace ergonomics

requirements.description: Implement responsive CSS grid layout that renders 2-column panes on desktop (>=768px) and single-column stacked panes on mobile (<768px). Pane containers must support dynamic addition and removal without full re-render.
requirements.title: Responsive Pane Grid Layout

validation.notes: Pane grid selector registered in selector registry
Pane layout config constants exported (min width/height)
Workspace renders pane grid, empty state, header controls, nav buttons, drawer toggle

requirements.description: Each pane operates an independent terminal session with its own PTY, input/output stream, and lifecycle. Pane creation allocates a new session; pane destruction tears down the session cleanly.
requirements.title: Independent Pane Session Lifecycle

validation.notes: Pane destruction cleans up session resources
Session limit enforced to prevent resource exhaustion
Workspace multi-pane rendering, error banner with retry, launcher integration
BAS case launches two panes with distinct command markers and verifies output isolation

requirements.description: PTY allocation creates isolated process per session. Cleanup on termination releases file descriptors and signals child process.
requirements.title: PTY Allocation and Cleanup

validation.notes: PTY factory creates and manages process lifecycle

requirements.description: Pane add/remove controls visible in workspace header. Add opens a new terminal; close tears down the pane session with confirmation if process is running.
requirements.title: Pane Management Controls

validation.notes: Create session API endpoint returns session info
Header New button, drawer toggle, sessions/settings nav buttons in Workspace

requirements.description: Messages open reliably for multi-thousand-event sessions with a bounded first render; scrolling is anchored and stable; whole-history search, jump, and export preserve access to events outside the loaded page while durable terminal sessions remain intact across a Web Console restart.
requirements.title: Bounded, Stable Conversation Messages

validation.notes: Virtualizer first render is bounded for a 2,500-event fixture and page refresh coverage verifies tail-only and older-page behavior.
Repository coverage verifies 2,500-event backward paging, oldest-history search, literal LIKE wildcard escaping, and legacy complete-history reads.

title: Pane-Based Terminal Workspace
